ai-opensource-tech-due-diligence 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Automates GitHub Trending project monitoring, in-depth technical analysis, and WeChat article generation.
- Integrates multiple skills: Agent-Reach (data fetch), tech-article-pro (analysis), wechat-article-pro (long-form writing), feishu-create-doc (knowledge base sync).
- Offers workflow to analyze repositories, generate structured reports, and publish to WeChat and Feishu.
- Supports custom analysis dimensions and publishing styles.
- Provides troubleshooting guide and best practices for integration and usage.
